endpoints.summary: Authenticate user and set JWT tokens in the browser cookies
endpoints.description:
When a user makes a request, the default authentication class defined in the DRF settings is not applied; that is, anyone can perform the operation. When the login is successful, JWT cookies are set in the browser. Considering different cases:

A - User is not yet logged in (no cookies in the browser):
The operation proceeds, verifying the credentials (responses below) and setting the cookies.

B - The user is already logged in (already has cookies in the browser):
The operation also proceeds normally too, however, the access and refresh cookies set in the previous login are invalidated within the blacklist.

permissions.authorization: Público; exige e-mail e senha válidos.
